narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Tilt the rectangle over, like a hinged frame, and you get a rhombus.
<bookmark mark='sides'/>Tilting keeps the long and short sides unequal, so it is not a rhombus.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Tilting also lowers the height, so the area shrinks as well.
